description: This Java class defines a `GLColor` object used for representing colors with RGBA components within an Android Open Source Project sample. It includes constructors for color initialization and an overridden equals method for comparison.

classes.name: GLColor
classes.description: Represents a color with red, green, blue, and alpha components for graphics rendering in an Android API sample.

methods.name: GLColor(int red, int green, int blue, int alpha)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes all color components explicitly.

methods.name: GLColor(int red, int green, int blue)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes color components and sets a default alpha value.

methods.name: equals(Object other)
methods.description: Overrides Object's equals method to compare color objects based on their RGBA values.
